Cinematic photorealistic film still. A 13 year old student with medium brown skin and short dark curly hair sits at a bedroom desk late at night, lit only by a warm amber desk lamp against deep teal-blue darkness. An open mathematics textbook covers the desk. A smartphone lies face-up on the open pages, its screen glowing bright white-blue and clearly buzzing with an unreadable notification. The student's face is lit from below by the screen, expression tense and caught mid-breath, one hand hovering just above the phone without touching it. Background falls away into soft shadow, a bedroom wall with faint posters out of focus.

Style: cinematic photorealistic, moody low-key lighting, deep teal-navy shadows with warm amber practical light, shallow depth of field, 35mm anamorphic, subtle film grain, natural skin tones, strong emotional tension.

Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no captions, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no logos, no UI text on the phone screen.
